task: P3 ML-hygiene audit: scaler/normalization data-leakage in the DESI 5-fold + OOD reproducibility metrics
trigger: Gemini RS10 + re-sweep flag: 'normalization/standardization scalers fit on full data rather than train splits, leaking into held-out reproducibility metrics (5-fold J=0.862, OOD J=0.732)'.
method: Static audit of the committed BigAE spectroscopic pipeline + the k-fold/OOD scripts, cross-checked against committed result JSONs. No fabrication; numbers reproduced from committed artifacts.

spectroscopic_path_DESI_SDSS_LAMOST_Plan.normalization: PER-SPECTRUM median normalization: each 496-bin resampled spectrum is divided by its own nonzero-bin median (resample_to_desi / resample_to_desi_grid). This is a row-wise transform computed from that spectrum's own values ONLY.
spectroscopic_path_DESI_SDSS_LAMOST_Plan.reason: A row-wise (per-sample) normalization is mathematically independent of the train/held-out split boundary; no dataset-fit StandardScaler / feature-wise mean-std is used anywhere in train_desi_kfold.py, score_desi_kfold.py, aggregate_kfold.py, or the OOD ensemble scorer. There is nothing to re-fit train-split-only because nothing is fit across samples.

tabular_path_eROSITA_NEOWISE_Gaia.normalization: Feature-wise standardization / robust median-IQR scaling FIT ON THE FULL SAMPLE, then an 80/20 split. This IS a genuine train/val leakage path and is already disclosed in the paper (Sec Training, L821).
tabular_path_eROSITA_NEOWISE_Gaia.already_bounded: erosita_scaler_refit.json: identical seeds, ONLY scaler-fit population differs (A=full-sample, B=train-split-only). top-298 Jaccard(A,B)=0.758, top-1% Jaccard(A,B)=0.643, full-catalog Spearman=0.941, val_loss A=0.02549 vs B=0.02537 (near-identical). The scaler-fit effect is at/below the model-retrain reproducibility floor (~15-17% extreme-tail churn under either perturbation); per-survey rates and within-survey rankings are robust; only individual extreme-tail memberships carry the quantified ~15% churn. eROSITA is a membership-only exploratory tier and produces no >=0.70 reproducibility-gate headline number.

reproducibility_gate_numbers.note: These headline numbers sit on the per-spectrum-normalized spectroscopic path and are therefore ALREADY leak-free. The audit does not change them; re-fitting a scaler train-split-only is a no-op here because no cross-sample scaler exists on this path.

verdict: The flag conflates the two P3 pipelines. The J=0.862 / J=0.732 numbers it names are on the per-spectrum-normalized spectroscopic path, which is split-independent and carries NO scaler leakage; they stand unchanged and both PASS their gates. The genuine full-sample-scaler leakage exists ONLY on the tabular tiers (eROSITA/NEOWISE/Gaia), which was already disclosed and already bounded by the committed train-split-only refit control (erosita_scaler_refit.json). No headline reproducibility number is leaked or requires correction.
action_taken: Added an explicit no-leakage clarification to the DESI 5-fold paragraph (Sec Path-C validation) stating the spectroscopic normalization is per-spectrum/row-wise and therefore split-independent, cross-referencing the separately-bounded tabular scalers.
